sha_of() { sha256sum "$1" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1; }
last_req=""
[ -f "$DIR/reload.request" ] && last_req="$(cat "$DIR/reload.request" 2>/dev/null || true)"
while kill -0 "$child" 2>/dev/null; do
  if [ -f "$DIR/reload.request" ]; then
    req="$(cat "$DIR/reload.request" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [ -n "$req" ] && [ "$req" != "$last_req" ]; then
      want="${req%% *}"
      # A request names the file it was written for. A mismatch means a
      # newer write is in flight; retry on the next tick.
      if [ "$want" = "$(sha_of "$PRINCIPALS")" ]; then
        kill -HUP "$child"
        printf '%s %s\n' "$want" "$(date +%s)" > "$DIR/.reload.ack.tmp" && mv -f "$DIR/.reload.ack.tmp" "$DIR/reload.ack"
        log "principals reload signalled (sha256 $want)"
        last_req="$req"
      fi
    fi
  fi
  sleep 2 &
  wait $! 2>/dev/null || true
done
